time.desc: The audit firm formally resigned as an auditor of a public company, questioning the independence of financial statements and management.
The company submitted an extension to its compliance plan to the exchange and hired a new auditor
The exchange formally approved the extension application and extended the financial report submission cutoff to a specific period.
Company officially removed from major market indexes
The company pressed the cutoff to submit overdue annual reports and quarterly reports and re-complied with listing application requirements.
The company disclosed that the internal control over financial reporting had significant deficiencies and failed to operate effectively.
Company CEO arrested on suspicion of export control violations
Law Firm Files Securities Class Action Lawsuit on Representation of Investors, Adds Charges Alleging Company Falsely Claimed to Comply with Export Controls to Certain Countries
The company submitted a document to disclose the resignation of the auditor. The stock price plummeted by nearly 50% in two days, and the market value fell below the threshold of important indexes.

The resignation of the auditor triggered concerns about index deletion. The company issued a business update after the market closed and said it was actively looking for a new auditor and revising the loan agreement.

The company did not clarify the time for submitting the annual report, causing the stock price to plummet by about 20% in a single day. The investment bank downgraded the rating to underweight and significantly reduced the target price.

The company announced that it was unable to submit its quarterly report on time and lowered its quarterly revenue forecast, facing the chain risk of delisting due to early repayment of convertible bonds.
The company hired a member firm of a large global accounting network as a new independent auditor, and the stock price rose by double digits for the second consecutive day
Analysts rated the hiring of a new auditor as a major positive development, and the stock price rebounded by nearly 80% in a single week
The company formally implemented a stock split plan, splitting each share into multiple shares to enhance liquidity.

The original audit agency submitted a resignation letter, stating that the company's financial reports were too suspicious and that it no longer relied on the statements of management and the audit committee.
The company disclosed the third revision of the loan agreement, extending the period for providing audited financial documents and adding a minimum unlimited cash clause
The company received a non-compliance notification letter from the exchange, confirming that it violated the listing rules due to delay in submitting annual and quarterly reports.
The company's stock price rose by more than 30% in a single day, but it is still down by about 75% from the historical high during the year.
The exchange approved the extension of the listing period to a specified date and required the company to submit overdue annual and quarterly reports before that.

The special committee announced its final investigation results and determined that there was no fraud or misconduct by management and the board of directors, and there was no need to restate historical financial reports.
The Board of Directors adopted the recommendations of the Special Committee, appointed a new Chief Accounting Officer and approved transition arrangements for the Chief Financial Officer.
The company's stock price rose by about 30% in a single day as the investigation results were revealed.
The company confirmed that it had received a letter from the exchange and was allowed to extend the compliance period, and the stock price rose sharply before the market opened.
The exchange officially approved the company's application for an extension to submit financial documents, and the stock will continue to be listed during the period.
Analysts raised the company's target price, anticipating a return of investors after the regulatory decision was announced.
The exchange announced that its decision to remove the company from the market index will officially take effect in a few days and announced the list of replacement companies.
